rows.metrics: Counters: validated records, resolved references and refusals (count, sums). Gauges: active validation (operations) and estimated live input-carrier bytes during validation. Histograms: records per assembled boundary (count), estimated validation input bytes and inclusive elapsed seconds. The contract-keyed spans carry the bounded operation field; started/completed metric series carry the bounded operation vocabulary derived from the operation registry, plus the common finite outcome set; other instruments remain aggregate.
rows.name: pn-records

rows.metrics: Counters: checked openings, matched commitments and refusals (count). Gauges: active checks (operations) and bounded working bytes. Histograms: opening sizes (bytes), dependency counts and inclusive elapsed seconds. Nonces, salts, private payloads and intermediate pre-digests remain secret; a match makes no authentication claim.
rows.name: pn-act-profile
rows.operations: check profile shape and bounds, project canonical values, recompute commitments and compare supplied openings with supplied recorded residues

rows.metrics: Counters: acts, projections, visited edges, numeric primitives and refinements (count). Gauges: live nodes/edges (count), scratch bytes and requested precision (bits). Histograms: closure sizes (count), enclosure work (count) and elapsed seconds.
rows.name: pn-graph
rows.operations: formation, complete projection, closure partition, geometry, recognition, title folds and numeric enclosure operations

rows.metrics: Counters: compiled acts, sparse products, rung attempts, iterations, refinements and outcomes (count). Gauges: active solves, support nonzeros (count) and scratch bytes. Histograms: primitive work (count), precision (bits) and elapsed seconds. Deterministic budget counters are mirrored one way.
rows.name: pn-epoch
rows.operations: compile ledger/cells/recipients/base, certify fence, search rungs, solve, check residual, admission and schedule validation

rows.metrics: Counters: encoded/decoded bytes, queries, successor attempts, commits, rollbacks, retries and refusals (count). Gauges: active transactions and queue depth (count). Histograms: package bytes, query/transaction elapsed seconds. Metric attributes use bounded categories for cardinality; traces record full SQL, parameters, public results and errors, with private configuration represented by its secret role and marker.
rows.name: pn-host
rows.operations: assemble/validate/encode/decode publication and, under the storage-placement proposal, open-store, load-boundary, append-effective-successor, commit-admitted-epoch

rows.metrics: Counters: reconstructed sections, compared fields and mismatches by bounded class (count), input bytes. Gauges: active replays (count) and working bytes. Histograms: reconstruction work (count) and elapsed seconds; no binding comparison of observation output.
rows.name: pn-replay
rows.operations: decode input, reconstruct each stage and compare canonical/semantic evidence

rows.metrics: Counters: visited prefixes, paths, emitted samples and limit outcomes (count). Gauges: active traversals (count) and working bytes. Histograms: path lengths (edges), traversal work (count) and elapsed seconds.
rows.name: pn-readouts
rows.operations: enumerate raw path prefixes, emit readouts and report limit refusals

rows.metrics: Counters: executed cases and outcomes (count), never a passed count for skipped evidence. Gauges: active cases (count) and known fixture bytes. Histograms: case work (count) and elapsed seconds; bounded case classes, not arbitrary fixture identifiers, are metric attributes.
rows.name: pn-verification
rows.operations: execute fixtures, independent oracles, mutation checks and evidence classification
